隐私政策 Privacy Policy

Account Password Helper 浏览器扩展 Account Password Helper Browser Extension

最后更新：2026年10月8日 · 生效日期：2026年10月8日 Last updated: October 8, 2026 · Effective: October 8, 2026

核心承诺：账号、密码、URL、备注、TOTP 密钥与身份信息逐字段加密后只写入您本机的浏览器存储，不上传任何服务器；本扩展的全部网络行为只有第 4 节列出的两类匿名请求。本政策另逐节说明了数据保留与删除的具体路径（第 8 节）、我们采取的安全措施（第 9 节）、每一类数据的使用目的与单一用途（第 10 节）、不出售不共享不转移（第 11 节），以及 GDPR / CCPA 等法规下您的权利如何行使（第 12 节）。

1. 概述

Account Password Helper（以下简称"本扩展"）是一款开源的 Chrome 浏览器扩展，用于管理和自动填充账号密码。本隐私政策说明我们如何收集、使用和保护您的信息。

本扩展的源代码完全开源，您可以在 GitHub 上查阅和审计所有代码。

2. 数据收集

本扩展不收集、不接收、也不传输您的任何个人数据。您录入的账号、密码、URL、备注、TOTP 密钥与身份信息，自始至终只在您自己的设备上被处理；我们之所以能这样承诺，是因为本扩展没有任何自有服务器，也没有任何数据上报通道——不存在一个「我们这边」可以存放您的数据的地方。具体来说：

  • 不使用任何分析工具（如 Google Analytics、Mixpanel 等）
  • 不包含任何遥测或追踪代码
  • 不记录用户行为或使用统计
  • 不收集设备信息或浏览器指纹
  • 不要求注册账号、不采集邮箱或姓名，安装即可使用，因此我们不持有可用于识别您的标识符
  • 页面上读取的表单结构（输入框位置、选择器、域名）只用于定位要填充或锚定的字段，用完即弃，不写入任何存储、不外传
  • 「自动保存」为可选项且默认关闭：只有您在登录后的确认弹窗中点击保存，该条凭据才会加密写入本机存储（详见第 3 节）

3. 数据存储

所有数据仅存储在您的本地浏览器中（使用 Chrome Storage Local API），不会同步到云端或任何远程服务器。

敏感数据（用户名、密码、URL、备注、两步验证码密钥）逐字段使用以下方式加密：

  • 加密算法：AES-256-GCM（认证加密）
  • 密钥派生：PBKDF2，600,000 次迭代，SHA-256
  • 加密实现：浏览器原生 Web Crypto API（无第三方加密库）
  • 随机数：使用密码学安全的随机数生成器（crypto.getRandomValues）

主密码不以明文保存，磁盘上只留有加盐的 PBKDF2（SHA-256，600,000 次迭代）校验值。

请这样理解「保持登录」：会话有效期内，用于恢复登录状态的密钥材料（数据密钥的包装值与包裹密钥）会随密文一起留在本机磁盘上， 这既是不重新输入主密码就能重启浏览器的原因，也意味着能读取这台电脑上该浏览器配置文件的程序，在此期间足以把数据解密。 手动锁定、闲置锁定或会话过期都会立即销毁这份密钥材料（只留一枚打不开任何东西的随机包裹密钥）。在共用电脑上，请在「自动锁定设置」中开启「浏览器重启锁定」： 完全关闭浏览器后密钥材料即被清除，重新打开必须输入主密码。

一处明文例外：为某条密码设置到期提醒时，该条的账号名会以明文冗余记录在本地的到期提醒表中（提醒由系统在任意时刻发出桌面通知， 含已锁定状态，账号名用于让通知指明是哪个账号），它同时会留下「哪个账号将在何时到期」这一信息；删除该条提醒、删除对应条目或清空回收站都会连带清除这条明文记录。

身份信息（姓名、证件号、手机号、邮箱、住址、银行卡信息与自定义字段）单独成库，整块以 AES-256-GCM 认证加密后写入本地存储，默认掩码显示，查看或复制均需再次验证主密码。

4. 网络通信

本扩展仅进行以下两类网络请求，二者均不携带任何用户数据：

  • Chrome 应用商店可达性探测：版本检查时先向 chromewebstore.google.com 发送一次轻量 HEAD 请求（结果本地缓存 24 小时），仅用于判断您能否直接在商店里更新。
  • 版本更新检查：每 6 小时一次；当上一步探测到商店不可达（如网络受限环境）时，改向 GitHub 公开 API（api.github.com）发送一次只读请求，此请求不发送任何用户数据，仅接收版本号和更新说明。

除此之外，本扩展不进行任何其他网络通信。密码的导入/导出、邮件备份提醒均为本地操作。

5. 权限使用说明

本扩展使用以下 Chrome 权限，每项均有明确的功能用途：

权限 用途
storage 在本地浏览器中存储加密后的密码数据、身份信息和用户设置
activeTab 在当前标签页中检测登录表单并执行自动填充
scripting 向网页注入表单检测和自动填充脚本
sidePanel 提供侧边栏面板用于管理密码
alarms 定时检查版本更新、自动备份提醒和 Service Worker 常驻保活（后台约每 20 秒唤醒一次，用于保证侧边栏秒开）
notifications 发送版本更新和备份提醒通知
idle 检测用户空闲状态以实现自动锁定
clipboardWrite 复制密码到剪贴板并自动清除
clipboardRead 读取剪贴板以验证自动清除前内容未被替换
webNavigation 监听页面导航事件以优化表单检测时机
contextMenus 在网页右键菜单中提供填充入口（填充用户名/密码/两步验证码、生成强密码、打开侧边栏或管理页）
favicon 读取 Chrome 本地图标缓存（_favicon/ 端点），在密码列表与侧边栏展示站点图标，零外部网络请求
<all_urls>（host） 在任意网站上检测登录表单并提供自动填充功能

6. 第三方服务

本扩展在运行时不使用任何第三方服务、CDN 或外部脚本。所有代码均打包在扩展内部运行，内容安全策略（CSP）限制为仅允许加载自身资源（script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'）。

7. 数据导出与备份

本扩展提供多种本地数据导出方式：

  • CSV/JSON 导出：生成本地文件下载，不经过任何服务器；文件为明文（含账号与密码），请妥善保管，长期留存建议改用加密备份
  • 加密备份（.aph）：使用 AES-256-GCM 加密的本地文件
  • 身份信息加密备份（.aphid）：使用 AES-256-GCM 加密的本地文件，仅本地导出导入；身份信息不参与自动备份，请定期手动导出
  • 身份信息明文导出 / 导入（.json，可选）：供迁移到其他工具查看的未加密导出，需验证主密码并经风险二次确认后方可进行；文件为明文（含姓名、证件号、银行卡号、CVV 等），任何能访问该文件的人均可直接读取。该明文 .json 也可经「导入」按 id 合并重新导入（同样需验证主密码并确认风险），请谨慎使用并妥善保管
  • 邮件备份：默认走「加密备份」档，导出 .aph 密文文件后经 mailto: 唤起系统邮件客户端；改选「不加密备份」会先要求风险二次确认、再复验主密码，产物是含账号与密码的明文 CSV。两种形态下扩展本身都不发送邮件、也不接触邮件服务器
  • 站点规则导出（JSON）：仅为该域名的填充选择器配置（域名 + CSS 选择器），不含账号、密码等任何凭据；文件为明文本地下载，不经过任何服务器，用于备份或团队共享

8. 数据保留与删除

保留位置与期限：您的全部数据只保存在本机的 chrome.storage.local 中，保留到您主动删除它们或卸载本扩展为止。我们没有任何服务端副本、日志、数据库或远程备份——因此不存在「请你们那边删掉」这种请求的对象；删除动作全部发生在您自己的设备上。

您可以使用的删除路径：

  • 删除单条条目：条目先移入回收站，在回收站中彻底删除或「清空回收站」后，其密文即从本机存储移除
  • 身份信息库：整块独立加密存储，删除条目即移除对应的密文块；清空回收站同样连带清理
  • 到期提醒：删除该条提醒、删除对应条目或清空回收站，都会一并清除提醒表里那条明文的账号名记录（见第 3 节）
  • 「忘记密码？重置所有数据」：主密码无法找回，重置会清空本机全部密码数据且不可撤销——这是忘记主密码时唯一的路径，操作前有二次确认
  • 卸载扩展：扩展被移除时，Chrome 会一并清除它在 chrome.storage.local 中的数据
  • 密码历史快照：每条默认保留 3 份旧密码（可配 1~10），随所属条目一同删除

您导出的文件（CSV / JSON / .aph / .aphid /站点规则 JSON）离开扩展后就归您所有，删除只能在您存放它们的位置进行；其中明文形态的文件包含可直接读取的凭据，请按第 7 节的提示妥善保管。

9. 安全措施

  • 静态加密：账号、密码、URL、备注、TOTP 密钥逐字段以 AES-256-GCM 认证加密后落盘；身份信息库整块加密
  • 密钥来源：数据密钥由主密码经 PBKDF2-SHA-256（600,000 次迭代 + 随机盐）在本机派生；主密码本身从不保存，磁盘上只留有加盐的校验值
  • 本地运算：全部加解密由浏览器原生 Web Crypto API 完成，不引入第三方加密库，也不调用任何远端密码学服务
  • 会话密钥销毁：手动锁定、闲置锁定与会话到期都会立即销毁内存与磁盘上的会话密钥材料；「保持登录」在这段有效期内留下的密钥材料及其风险已在第 3 节明示，共用电脑建议开启「浏览器重启锁定」
  • 剪贴板：复制密码后自动清除，并在清除前校验内容未被替换（这是 clipboardRead 权限的唯一用途）
  • 二次验证：身份信息的查看与复制需重新验证主密码，默认掩码显示；明文导出与「不加密备份」需风险二次确认并复验主密码
  • 投递面收窄：自动填充默认按精确主机名匹配站点规则才放宽，避免把凭据投递到仿冒或相邻域名；主密码输入框实时检测大写锁定
  • 代码与权限边界：CSP 限制为 script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'，不加载远程代码；权限取最小集合且逐项标注用途（第 5 节）；页面 DOM、导入文件与运行时消息一律按不可信输入做类型、长度与来源校验
  • 可审计性：源代码以 GPL-3.0 完整公开，上述每一条都可以在仓库中对照实现验证，无需相信我们的自述

10. 数据的使用目的（单一用途）

本扩展的用途是单一的：在您本机安全地保存账号凭据，并替您在自己的网站上完成填充与登录辅助。每一类被经手的信息只服务于这条链路上的一个目的：

  • 凭据（账号 / 密码 / TOTP 密钥 / 身份信息）：只用于「加密存储 → 会话内解密 → 填充、复制或展示」，以及您主动发起的导出与备份
  • 页面表单结构与当前域名：只用于定位要填充的输入框、锚定要填写的验证码胶囊，以及决定该展示哪些条目和按哪一档匹配
  • 您自定义的站点规则：只用于在您指定的域名上改用您指定的选择器
  • 版本信息：更新检查只读取公开的最新版本号与不超过 200 字的更新说明，唯一用途是提示您可以升级（第 4 节）

明确不做用途之外的处理：不用于广告投放或用户画像，不用于训练任何模型，不出售、不共享（第 11 节），也不与第 4 节之外的任何系统或第三方交换数据。

11. 不出售、不共享、不转移

我们不出售、不出租、不以物易物，也不以任何方式向第三方共享或转移您的个人数据或凭据信息；不使用广告网络、数据经纪商或分析服务商；不把数据托管到任何云存储服务。由于没有任何数据离开您的设备，也就不存在云服务提供商访问、跨境转移或第三方执法调取数据副本的情形——没有可被调取的副本。本扩展不在任何意义上是您的数据的管理者或中间人。

12. 适用法规与您的权利

因为我们不接收、不持有也不传输您的任何个人数据，本扩展的开发者不担任任何个人数据的控制者或处理者。GDPR、CCPA/CPRA 等法规赋予的访问、更正、删除、可携带、退出「出售」或「共享」等权利，在这里都对应一个更简单的动作：本机数据由您直接删除，或卸载扩展（见第 8 节），无需向我们提出请求，也无需等待响应。

如果您仍希望就隐私事项联系开发者（例如所在组织的合规审查需要书面说明），请使用第 15 节的联系方式；我们会按适用法律予以响应。

13. 儿童隐私

本扩展不会有意收集任何用户（包括 13 岁以下儿童）的个人信息。所有数据仅存储在用户本地设备上。

14. 隐私政策变更

如本隐私政策有任何变更，将在本页面更新并标注变更日期。重大变更将通过扩展内通知提示用户。

Core Commitment: Account names, passwords, URLs, notes, TOTP secrets and identity fields are encrypted field by field and written only to your browser's local storage — never uploaded to any server. All network activity this extension performs is limited to the two anonymous requests listed in Section 4. This policy also sets out, section by section: how long data is retained and every path you can use to delete it (Section 8), the security measures we take (Section 9), the purpose of use for each category of information and our single-purpose commitment (Section 10), that we do not sell, share or transfer anything (Section 11), and how you exercise your rights under GDPR, CCPA and similar laws (Section 12).

1. Overview

Account Password Helper (hereafter "the Extension") is an open-source Chrome browser extension for managing and auto-filling account credentials. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.

The Extension's source code is fully open-source. You can review and audit all code on GitHub.

2. Data Collection

The Extension does not collect, receive, or transmit any of your personal data. The account names, passwords, URLs, notes, TOTP secrets and identity fields you enter are processed exclusively on your own device. We can make that commitment because the Extension has no servers of its own and no data-reporting channel — there is no "our side" where your data could ever end up. Specifically:

  • No analytics tools are used (no Google Analytics, Mixpanel, etc.)
  • No telemetry or tracking code is included
  • No user behavior or usage statistics are recorded
  • No device information or browser fingerprints are collected
  • No account sign-up, email address or name is required, so we hold no identifier that could be used to recognise you
  • Page structure we read (input positions, selectors, the current domain) is used only to locate the field to fill or the code capsule to anchor, is discarded immediately, never written to storage and never sent anywhere
  • "Auto-save" is optional and off by default: a credential is encrypted into local storage only after you tap Save in the confirmation dialog that follows your sign-in (see Section 3)

3. Data Storage

All data is stored exclusively in your local browser (via Chrome Storage Local API) and is never synced to the cloud or any remote server.

Sensitive data (usernames, passwords, URLs, remarks, TOTP secrets) is encrypted field by field with the following:

  • Encryption: AES-256-GCM (authenticated encryption)
  • Key Derivation: PBKDF2 with 600,000 iterations, SHA-256
  • Implementation: Browser-native Web Crypto API (no third-party crypto libraries)
  • Randomness: Cryptographically secure random number generator (crypto.getRandomValues)

The master password is never stored in plaintext — only a salted PBKDF2 (SHA-256, 600,000 iterations) verifier is kept.

What "stay signed in" really means: while a session is valid, the key material that restores it (the wrapped data key and its wrap key) stays on this device's disk alongside the ciphertext. That is why a browser restart needs no master password — and it also means any program able to read this browser profile on this machine can decrypt your data during that window. Manual lock, idle lock and session expiry destroy that key material immediately (leaving a random wrap key that opens nothing). On a shared computer, turn on "Lock on browser restart" under Auto lock settings: fully closing the browser then clears the key material, and reopening requires the master password.

One plaintext exception: when you set an expiry reminder for an entry, that entry's username is redundantly recorded in plaintext in the local reminder table, because reminders fire as desktop notifications at any moment — including while locked — and the username is what makes the notice name an account. It also leaves behind which account is expiring and when. Deleting that reminder, deleting the entry, or emptying the trash clears the record.

Identity information (name, ID number, phone, email, address, bank card details and custom fields) is kept in a separate vault, stored locally only as one AES-256-GCM authenticated-encrypted blob; it is masked by default, and viewing or copying it requires verifying the master password again.

4. Network Communication

The Extension makes only the two requests below, and neither one carries any user data:

  • Chrome Web Store reachability probe: when checking for updates, one lightweight HEAD request goes to chromewebstore.google.com (the result is cached locally for 24 hours) purely to work out whether you can update right inside the store.
  • Version update check: every 6 hours; only when the probe above reports the store as unreachable (e.g. restricted networks) is a read-only request sent to GitHub's public API (api.github.com). No user data is sent — only version numbers and release notes are received.

No other network communication occurs. Password import/export and email backup reminders are all local operations.

5. Permissions Usage

The Extension uses the following Chrome permissions, each with a specific functional purpose:

Permission Purpose
storage Store encrypted password data, identity information and user settings locally
activeTab Detect login forms and perform auto-fill on the current tab
scripting Inject form detection and auto-fill scripts into web pages
sidePanel Provide a side panel for password management
alarms Schedule version update checks, auto-backup reminders, and always-on Service Worker keepalive (background wakeup roughly every 20 seconds to keep the side panel instantly available)
notifications Send version update and backup reminder notifications
idle Detect user idle state for auto-lock functionality
clipboardWrite Copy passwords to clipboard with auto-clear
clipboardRead Read clipboard to verify content hasn't been replaced before auto-clearing
webNavigation Monitor page navigation events to optimize form detection timing
contextMenus Provide fill entries in the page right-click menu (fill username/password/2FA code, generate a strong password, open the side panel or manager page)
favicon Read site icons from Chrome's local favicon cache (the _favicon/ endpoint) for password list and side panel entries — zero external network requests
<all_urls> (host) Detect login forms and provide auto-fill on any website

6. Third-Party Services

The Extension does not use any third-party services, CDNs, or external scripts at runtime. All code is bundled within the extension, and the Content Security Policy (CSP) restricts loading to self-only resources (script-src 'self'; object-src 'self').

7. Data Export & Backup

The Extension provides several local data export options:

  • CSV/JSON Export: Local file downloads without passing through any server; the files are plaintext (usernames and passwords included), so store them safely — prefer an encrypted backup for long-term retention
  • Encrypted Backup (.aph): AES-256-GCM encrypted local files
  • Identity Encrypted Backup (.aphid): AES-256-GCM encrypted local files, exported and imported locally only; identity information is not covered by automatic backups, so export it regularly
  • Identity Plaintext Export / Import (.json, optional): an unencrypted export for migrating to other tools, allowed only after verifying the master password and confirming the risk; the file is plaintext (name, ID number, card number, CVV, etc.) readable by anyone who can access it. The same plaintext .json can also be re-imported through the identity import entry and merged by id, likewise requiring master-password verification and risk confirmation — use with care and store securely
  • Email Backup: defaults to the encrypted tier, producing an .aph ciphertext file handed to your mail client via the mailto: protocol; choosing "Plain backup" first requires a risk acknowledgement and then master-password re-verification, and the artifact is a plaintext CSV holding usernames and passwords. Either way the Extension sends no email and touches no mail server
  • Site Rule Export (JSON): fill-selector configuration only (domains plus CSS selectors), no usernames, passwords or any other credentials; the file is plaintext downloaded locally without passing through any server, intended for backup or team sharing

8. Data Retention & Deletion

Where and how long: all of your data lives only in chrome.storage.local on your own machine, and is retained until you delete it or uninstall the Extension. We keep no server-side copy, log, database or remote backup of any kind — so there is no object for a "please delete it on your side" request; every deletion happens on your device.

Deletion paths available to you:

  • Single entry: a deleted entry first moves to the trash; permanently removing it there or emptying the trash removes its ciphertext from local storage
  • Identity vault: stored as its own encrypted block — removing an entry removes that block, and emptying the trash cleans it up as well
  • Expiry reminders: removing the reminder, removing the related entry, or emptying the trash all clear the plaintext account-name record kept in the reminder table (see Section 3)
  • "Forgot password? Reset all data": the master password cannot be recovered, and resetting wipes all local password data irreversibly — it is the only path when the master password is lost, and it requires a confirmation step
  • Uninstalling the Extension: Chrome clears the extension's chrome.storage.local data when the extension is removed
  • Password history snapshots: 3 previous values per entry by default (configurable 1~10), removed together with the entry they belong to

Files you export (CSV / JSON / .aph / .aphid / site-rule JSON) leave the Extension and become yours to keep; they can only be deleted wherever you store them. Plaintext forms contain directly readable credentials, so handle them as Section 7 advises.

9. Security Measures

  • Encryption at rest: usernames, passwords, URLs, notes and TOTP secrets are encrypted field by field with AES-256-GCM (authenticated encryption); the identity vault is encrypted as a whole block
  • Key origin: the data key is derived on your device from the master password via PBKDF2-SHA-256 (600,000 iterations + random salt); the master password itself is never stored — only a salted verifier stays on disk
  • Local computation only: all cryptography runs through the browser-native Web Crypto API — no third-party crypto library, no remote cryptographic service
  • Session key destruction: manual lock, idle lock and session expiry all destroy the session key material immediately; the key material that "keep me signed in" leaves on disk during a valid session, and the risk that implies, are spelled out in Section 3 — enable "lock on browser restart" on shared machines
  • Clipboard: copied passwords are cleared automatically, and the content is verified unchanged before clearing (the sole purpose of the clipboardRead permission)
  • Step-up verification: identity fields are masked by default and require re-entering the master password to view or copy; plaintext exports and the "unencrypted backup" tier require a risk acknowledgement plus master-password re-verification
  • Narrow delivery surface: autofill matches the exact hostname by default and only widens through the tiers or site rules you choose, so credentials are not delivered to look-alike or neighbouring domains; the master-password field detects Caps Lock in real time
  • Code and permission boundaries: CSP is script-src 'self'; object-src 'self' with no remote code; permissions are the minimal set, each with its purpose listed in Section 5; page DOM, imported files and runtime messages are all treated as untrusted input and validated for type, length and origin
  • Auditability: the full source is published under GPL-3.0, so every claim above can be verified against the implementation rather than taken on our word

10. Purpose of Use (Single Purpose)

The Extension has one purpose: to store your credentials securely on your machine and to help you fill and sign in on your own sites. Every category of information it handles serves exactly one step of that chain:

  • Credentials (username / password / TOTP secret / identity fields): used only for "encrypt at rest → decrypt within the session → fill, copy or display", plus the exports and backups you start yourself
  • Page form structure and the current domain: used only to locate the input to fill, the code capsule to anchor, and to decide which entries to show and which matching tier applies
  • Site rules you define: used only to substitute your own selectors on the domains you specify
  • Version information: the update check reads only the public latest version number and a release note of at most 200 characters, used solely to tell you an upgrade is available (Section 4)

Nothing beyond that purpose: no advertising or user profiling, no training of any model, no sale or sharing (Section 11), and no data exchanged with any system or third party other than the two anonymous requests in Section 4.

11. No Sale, No Sharing, No Transfer

We do not sell, rent, trade, or otherwise share or transfer your personal data or credentials with any third party; we use no ad networks, data brokers, or analytics providers; and your data is never hosted on any cloud storage service. Because no data leaves your device, there is no cloud-provider access, no cross-border transfer, and no copy that could be subpoenaed — there is nothing to subpoena. In no sense are we a custodian or intermediary of your data.

12. Applicable Laws & Your Rights

Since we neither receive, hold, nor transmit any of your personal data, the developer of this Extension acts as neither controller nor processor of any personal data. The rights granted by GDPR, CCPA/CPRA and similar laws — access, rectification, erasure, portability, opting out of "sale" or "sharing" — map here onto a single simpler action: you delete the local data directly, or uninstall the Extension (see Section 8), without filing a request with us or waiting for a response.

If you still wish to reach the developer about privacy matters (for example, your organisation's compliance review needs it in writing), use the contact details in Section 15; we will respond in line with applicable law.

13. Children's Privacy

The Extension does not knowingly collect personal information from any user, including children under 13. All data is stored only on the user's local device.
